text:
Maria Gonzales: quick chase on the postmortem action items from the DB failover (Feb 18). Several owners still show overdue in the tracker (INC-4752, RM-23). Can owners confirm status and final ETA?
Jamal Carter: sorry, I'm behind on INC-4752 — got blocked on the infra test harness. ETA EOW if I don't hit more blockers.
Alex Chen: PR is up for RM-23: https://git.redwood/infra/rm-23 — needs a review for the test tweak. Tests failing in CI because of a flaky teardown.
Incident Bot: Reminder: 2 action items overdue for >7 days (INC-4752, RM-23). Please update owners or reassign.
Olivia Park: Jamal, can you confirm whether you need a hand or a scope-down to ship before EOW? If you need support, escalate to Ben and I'll prioritize pairing time.
Jamal Carter: I could use help with the harness — the failure mode looks like race on socket close. If Ben or Alex can pair tomorrow AM I can unblock quicker.
Ben Ross: I can pair tomorrow 09:30 PT. Alex, can you drop a short reproduce script in the PR so we can run locally?
Alex Chen: done — added `scripts/repro_socket_race.sh` to the branch and a short README note. Also added a flaky-test label to the CI job.
Maria Gonzales: thanks — when this is merged, please add a closure note to the postmortem doc (internal:docs/postmortems/db-failover-2026) with links to the PR and the commit, and then mark the action item resolved in the tracker. I need the closure comment for the monthly reliability report.
Jamal Carter: merged PR at commit 3f9a2b4, infra harness change fixed the race and CI is green. Updated INC-4752 status -> Resolved. Added closure note to the postmortem doc with root cause and mitigation steps. :white_check_mark:
Olivia Park: awesome — thanks Jamal & Ben & Alex. Maria, please confirm you see the tracker update and closure note.
Maria Gonzales: I see it, closure note looks good and includes the mitigation timeline. Marking this action item as verified closed on my side. I'll follow up if we need a retro about test reliability.
Incident Bot: Action items status changed: INC-4752 -> Resolved by Jamal Carter, RM-23 -> Resolved by Alex Chen.
Ben Ross: nice work team :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks — will open a follow-up ticket for CI flakiness triage (CI-982) so we don't reintroduce this.
Maria Gonzales: leaving this thread closed for now. If anything reopens, please @me and add the tracker link. Thanks everyone.
